parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears. <short pause> Psalm thirty-four, verse four.

God, I come to You tonight with all that troubles me. <short pause> You hear me when I call. <short pause> You have lifted fear from my heart before, and I trust You to do it again. <short pause> I lay my worries before You now. <short pause> Amen.
